title: The Big Rip
description: If dark energy is phantom - w below -1 - its density grows as space expands. Clusters, then galaxies, then stars and planets, then atoms are torn apart, all in a finite time. Unlocks the Phantom Energy Cell.

puzzle.goal: Dark energy with equation of state w below −1 grows denser as space expands, so the scale factor reaches infinity at a finite time. In a flat universe of matter fraction Ω_m expanding at H₀ today, the remaining time depends on how far w lies below −1. Write the time left until everything is torn apart.
puzzle.name: phantom-energy doomsday time (Big Rip)
puzzle.ask: With w, H₀ = H in km/s/Mpc (1/H₀ = 977.8/H Gyr) and Ω_m = Ω, find the time to the Rip in Gyr.
puzzle.method: Phantom energy dilutes as a^{−3(1+w)}, which grows. Once it dominates, H ∝ ρ^{1/2} blows up, and integrating da/(aH) gives a finite time.
